comparison.objective: Load a plate on each dumbbell sleeve and secure each with a collar.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual plate-hole alignment, sliding insertion, collar placement, and push-home finishing; no impact fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Plates within 1 cm of flanges and collars no more than 6 mm outside them; any plate left on a sleeve without a locked collar zeros the end score. Final release/stability tolerances are not specified.
comparison.reason: Shared coaxial insertion and safety constraints are insufficient for overlap; this tests assembly and retention of large parts, not tang fracture and fragment recovery.
